title: phegopteris serrata
intro: Phegopteris serrata, commonly known as Indian feather fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris serrata include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer properties, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
